purpose: VFX and HUD concepts generated and shared BEFORE gameplay/HUD implementation. These are modeling and layout targets, not screenshots of the running game.

images.prompt:
Create a new production art-direction sheet for the Japanese ridiculous 3D office escape game "全力退勤". The attached image is the CURRENT RUNNING GAME: use its teal office, red extinguisher, cream paper, navy outlines and rounded salaryman toys as continuity, but invent much stronger coherent VFX and arcade interface art. This is a concept design sheet to be implemented in Godot Web Compatibility with flat polygons and lightweight meshes, not a fake final screenshot. Wide 16:9 sheet, ivory background, 6 big clear panels in a 3-column 2-row grid, polished original Japanese comic arcade style, absolutely no browser chrome. Crisp deliberate heavy Japanese block typography, thick dark-navy contour, cream inset highlight, red/pink offset shadow, mustard/gold accents, cyan only near exhaust. No photorealistic bloom, lens flare, motion blur, photoflash or HUD clutter.
Panel1 labeled "噴射": red extinguisher nozzle pointing backward, a directional tapered cone of connected rounded white powder clouds growing from tiny to large with a thin cyan/dark-teal outline and 3 fast rear streaks, a compact comic "シュゴーッ!!", nozzle and source visibly clear.
Panel2 labeled "衝突": a local spiky gold burst with thick navy contour and pink offset, concentric thin shock rings, dramatic curved fan of 8 stamped paper sheets and 3 tiny beveled gold cubes, bold slanted "ドガァン!!", no gore.
Panel3 labeled "連鎖・ラッシュ": dimensional graphic number "3" in yellow with ivory inner stroke/navy contour/red hard offset, small "連鎖 ×3" cream ticket, magenta and gold jagged ribbon "定時ラッシュ！", gold and pink tapered edge-speed strokes; distinguish normal combo number from the one-time rush banner.
Panel4 labeled "退勤成功": oversized angled rubber stamp "退勤成功！" with thick red double rectangular outline and navy hard offset, shining gold rosette seal "SSS", small teal stamp "自己ベスト！", side fountains of cream stamped paper and gold/pink/cyan/teal ribbon confetti around a clear center.
Panel5 labeled "HUDの枠": related in-game components, dark-navy punch timecard "退勤TIME" with red/gold header tab, clip detail, ivory large timer "00:12.48"; cream expense receipt "被害総額" with ruled separators and red "¥480,000"; small red drawn extinguisher beside a segmented yellow pressure gauge "残圧 68%". Chunky graphic outlines, short dark offset shadows, paper notches and halftone accent patches. Counters are level and legible.
Panel6 labeled "文字・ボタン": Japanese logo "全力退勤" with red letter fill, ivory stroke and substantial navy extrusion-like offset, small gold "定時だ。飛べ。" ribbon; red primary button "退勤する →" with cream letters, black outline, gold upper rim and navy offset base; smaller ivory secondary button and dark keyboard keycaps "SPACE" "R" "ESC". Original joyful game styling tied to office paper/stamps, no generic SaaS panels. All six panels feel like one carefully art-directed game.

Create a polished 16:9 GAME SCREEN CONCEPT for the Japanese ridiculous 3D office escape game "全力退勤". Reference1 is the freshly designed VFX/HUD style guide; reference2 is the CURRENT REAL GAME. Use the exact existing rounded salaryman on the teal office chair with a red extinguisher, cream-tile office, teal guide lane, sunset left windows, chunky desks/CRT/paper towers and sleepy colleagues. Keep the office and gameplay camera recognizable: 3D rounded toy meshes with a flat Japanese comic arcade graphic layer. Do not replace the game with a 2D comic or introduce extra furniture/characters/abilities. Heavy original Japanese block typography, navy outlines, cream inner stroke, red or magenta short offset shadows, gold/teal accents, clipped/notched office-paper frames, halftone only in small graphic patches. No generic website panels, bloom, lens flare, motion blur or unreadable ornament. UI text crisp, fit inside safe margins; clear character face and floor route, all HUD counters level. The whole image is a design target, not browser chrome, device mockup or game-development tools.
ACTIVE GAMEPLAY at the first chain rush, same isometric following camera as current screenshot. Salaryman and chair near lower-center, height about28%ofscreen, face exaggerated but visibly the same asset. Strong short connected white powder cone from the extinguisher trails toward lower-left BEHIND the chair, with a cyan rim and 3 pointed rear speed streaks; front route and face unobscured. Small gold/pink paper-star bursts near a broken paper tower. Bold tapered gold and pink speed-lines confined to outer edges. Upper-left compact dark punch-card timer with red clock tab "退勤TIME", large ivory "00:12.48", metal clip. Upper-right cream torn receipt "被害総額" with ruled rows and red "¥480,000"; directly below it a gold/navy outlined big "3" with small cream ticket "連鎖 ×3". Top-center small green exit sign "EXIT ↑ 64m"; below it one gold-magenta jagged ribbon "定時ラッシュ！", separate small cream add-ticket "+¥150,000", both above hero and gameplay corridor. Lower-left chunky red-extinguisher drawing and segmented yellow pressure meter "残圧 68%" with ticks, cream notched background/navy frame. Lower-right compact outlined keyboard caps "← →" "SPACE" "R" "ESC" and a small pause tab. No giant permanent game logo on play screen. A loud memorable game interface with roomy central play area.
